transition_policy: Diagnostic full-frame persistent tile changes only; moving people and clocks may trigger candidates. Never identify these as shared panel events or export timing without physical-panel correspondence and switch-delay validation. No manual annotations.
track_policy: Native-resolution dynamic-mask SIFT and forward/backward LK with adjacent patch correlation; terminate on appearance discontinuity. Convert coordinates by (xy+0.5)/2-0.5 before using immutable calibration. Preserve original moving-track and full-search support gates.
fit_policy: One targeted temporal-bias fit, unchanged +/-25 integer search, 0.05 fractional grid, 0.25 uncertainty and cycle gates. Keep prior passing edges; add newly passing target edges without lag-dependent pruning. No reserved data until complete full-rig graph passes.
failure_policy: Preserve failed fit and transition diagnostics; stop at disconnected, bridge, uncertainty or cycle blocker. No threshold relaxation or advertising-event-only timing acceptance.
